# Dimitris Kotlidas

> White label performance marketing for digital agencies. Dimitris Kotlidas runs Meta Ads, Google Ads and tracking (server-side GTM, Meta CAPI, Enhanced Conversions, GA4) under the agency's own brand, so the agency adds a service without hiring. Based in Strasbourg, working in English with agencies across Europe.
